rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; f8863 p. 2, line 27; i8863 p. 3. As the prior rulings on this line: the reply has the education lines read person.edu_a2025 and person.edu_over for every person, with no f8863.paid gate, so it is unknown on returns with no education credit where the project hides the line; and it requires an issued TIN for the American opportunity credit, against p970 p. 11, "If an ATIN or ITIN is applied for on or before the due date of a 2025 return (including extensions) and the IRS issues an ATIN or ITIN as a result of the application, the IRS will consider the ATIN or ITIN as issued on or before the due date of the return". executable-triage-v2 (pass 5909c02fb1f9; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1,661 partial records; 4,595 comparisons): 3,642 of 4,595 agree; on completed returns 251 candidate-unknown and 2 value (classm.person.1 and f1.t113.person_aoc_itin_applied: project $4,000.00, reply 0, a student whose ITIN was applied for); 3 project-unknown on incomplete returns. No change to the data.

Ruling: model error; f8863 p. 2, line 27; p970 p. 11. This pass reviews the American opportunity credit test (edu_aoc) rewritten from one all-test into a nested choice in the form's order (lines 23 to 26, then the filers' TINs, then the EIN; BUG-0460), which changes no value on a complete return. As the prior rulings: the reply reads person.edu_over for every person (no f8863.paid gate), so it is unknown on returns with no education credit where the project hides the line; and it requires an issued TIN, against p970 p. 11, "If an ATIN or ITIN is applied for on or before the due date of a 2025 return (including extensions) and the IRS issues an ATIN or ITIN as a result of the application, the IRS will consider the ATIN or ITIN as is- sued on or before the due date of the return." (owner decision T-113). f1.t113.person_aoc_itin_applied (an American opportunity credit student whose ITIN was applied for) gives $0.00 where the project gives $4,000.00. mutation.t3.person_edu_1098t_unanswered is refused by the reply on its own edu_over declaration where the project is unknown (edu_1098t unanswered). executable-triage-v2 on this pass's reply (`.transcription/person.lines-01b5c635c5d7.response.txt`, merged over the whole review's reply; a scratch run of triage.mjs with the witness cap lifted, since triage.py evaluates the whole review's reply; 1,640 fixtures; 500 generated returns seed 20261026; 1,420 partial records; 4,399 comparisons): 1,842 of 4,399 agree; 2,555 candidate-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses, 1 value; on returns the full interview completes: 289 candidate-unknown person.edu_over (for example classm.f8889.1.deepseek); no completed-return value difference. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i8863 p. 3, Who cannot claim a credit: "5. The student has not been issued a TIN by the due date of his or her 2025 return (including extensions)"; p970 p. 11: "If an ATIN or ITIN is applied for on or before the due date of a 2025 return (including extensions) and the IRS issues an ATIN or ITIN as a result of the application, the IRS will consider the ATIN or ITIN as issued on or before the due date of the return"; i8863 p. 2: "You may be able to claim an education credit if you, your spouse, or a dependent you claim on your tax return was a student enrolled at or attending an eligible educational institution." The reply changed: its student gate now accepts person.tin or person.itin_applied, as the project's does, so fix round 3's TIN kind (an ITIN applied for and issued) is gone. Fix round 4 re-check: BUG-0259 rewords person.itin_applied to count an application to renew an expired ITIN; both sides read the answer in the same place, so the change moves both alike and creates no difference between them, and it is consistent with the deeming quoted (a renewal is filed as an application on Form W-7). It still omits f8863.paid, the return-level screen that precedes person.edu, so every candidate-unknown record on a completed return but one is a return with f8863.paid no, where the interview never asks the student's answers (edu and edu_over; classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .5, checked on each witness in a scratch rerun): an answer the source does not need (the other is a partial of classm.f8863.2.deepseek withholding edu_over for a person the project does not need it for). The worksheet arithmetic is the project's aqee definition; no value differs. Lines 27 to 30 also omit the filers' TIN test (household.all_tin, amb.2025.edu_filer_tin, owner decision D7(a)); no record isolates it. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/person.json; 1,390 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 2,014 partial records; every witness listed by a scratch rerun of tools/transcription/triage.mjs with the witness cap lifted): 2,372 of 4,724 comparisons agree; 2,352 candidate-unknown; on returns the full interview completes: 926 candidate-unknown.

Ruling: model error; i8863 p. 3, Who cannot claim a credit: "5. The student has not been issued a TIN by the due date of his or her 2025 return (including extensions)", and Student qualifications: "5. Filers and students must have been issued a TIN by the due date of their 2025 return (including extensions)." i8863 p. 2: "You may be able to claim an education credit if you, your spouse, or a dependent you claim on your tax return was a student enrolled at or attending an eligible educational institution." Same expression as round 1. The candidate omits the student-TIN test of edu_student (person.tin or person.itin_applied; p970 p. 11 treats an ITIN applied for by the due date and issued as issued by then) and f8863.paid, the return-level screen that precedes person.edu; lines 27 to 30 also omit the filers' TIN test (household.all_tin, amb.2025.edu_filer_tin, owner decision D7(a)). The partial of classm.f8863.4.deepseek withholding person.tin shows it: the project needs the TIN, the candidate gives $4,000.00. The candidate-unknown records are returns with f8863.paid no, where the interview never asks the student's answers (classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .5): its refusal declaration on person.edu_over is read before anything else, and with no expenses paid for anyone there is no student (the quoted p. 2 sentence), so it requires an answer the source does not need. Its edu_over refusal matches the reworded question (BUG-0197). The worksheet arithmetic (expenses less lines 2a to 2c, floored at zero; capped at $4,000; less $2,000; 25%; line 30 rule) is the project's aqee definition.
